tasks.short: Check that the detour signs are in place, then tell drivers at the site which detour route to take through or around the construction.

steps.what: Flagger checks that the detour signs are in place
Contractor planner checks the detour registration before it is published: road, dates, closed lanes and the detour route
Contractor planner registers the checked detour with the road authority's traffic data service
Flagger informs drivers of detour routes through construction sites

tasks.design: The contractor's planner checks the road works and detour and registers them with the road authority's traffic data service ({GOV_PORTAL}), so navigation apps route drivers around the site and fewer stop to ask the flagger. Telling drivers the way at the site stays with the flagger.
tasks.previous_blocker: Drivers learned of detours only at the site.
tasks.enabler_now: Road works registered with traffic data services show in navigation apps.
tasks.still_hard: Local drivers and trucks without navigation still stop to ask.
tasks.human_edge: Guiding a lost truck driver through a tight turn without blocking the site.

reach.learn: Whether fewer drivers stop at the site.

evidence.claim: Road works registered with public traffic data services can show in navigation apps.

assumptions: Boundary: from the traffic plan to drivers informed; the contractor planner's check and registration (s1c, s1r) are shown but are other-role time outside the flagger's savings.
Input contract: the contractor registers the detour; fallback is signs and the flagger.
Checking signs keeps its full time. s2 keeps 85 because fewer drivers stop to ask and telling those who do stays.
research_questions: Do fewer drivers stop to ask after the works are registered?

incremental.description: Flagger tells the site supervisor when the detour changes.

approvals.approved_version: The detour registration with road, dates, closed lanes and route exactly as checked by the contractor planner in s1c, published once to the road authority's traffic data service for these works; any change to the detour needs a new check and registration.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: most drivers on a rural site do not use navigation, so nearly as many stop to ask (3.4); high: a through route where most drivers follow navigation (11.4).

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The flagger keeps directing traffic and guiding drivers; fewer drivers stop to ask the way.
role.ambitious_version: A flagger whose attention stays on safety at the site.
